posts.author: Sikaran
posts.body:
DESCRIPTION:
Negative Impulse is a solodev dark fantasy RPG crafted using RPG Maker MV.
SYNOPSIS:
Many years before, in a world like ours, humans lived and were prosperous.  Each was different in their ways, but were united, not only by the language they spoke, but by the land where they lived, which spread out for a million square miles unbroken by ocean. This land, called Altima, was peaceful.
Until it shattered. Mountains drowned, seas thirsted. Fire flowed like water, and the four winds clawed through everything.
Time passed. Life struggled to live again. The people who remained cursed and wept, lost faith, regained it, then grit their teeth and moved on.
The land that remained to them was riven into uncounted shards, and humans, parted by the ocean, grew distant from each other...
INSPIRED BY:
Final Fantasy VI | Lunar: Silver Star Story Complete | Neverwinter Nights | Genso Suikoden II | The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim
MECHANICS:
Eternal Equipment | Swiss Knife Loadout | 5x Melee Damage Types | 16x Magic Damage Types | Smart Items | Tactical Turn-Based Combat | Item Harvesting, Crafting, & Cooking | Banking, Investing, & Trading | Guild Affiliation & Rankings | Fame & Infamy | Meister & Apprentice | Affection & Endearment
WORLDBUILDING INSPIRATIONS:
Filipino History & Culture | Science Fiction | Dark & Epic Fantasy | Seinen & Josei Anime & Manga | Yasumi Matsuno | Martial Arts | Wilderness Survival | Philosophy | Psychology | Cosmology | Indiana Jones & National Treasure
DISCLAIMER:
Uses Leonardo.AI for the intro sequence images (and possibly for future cutscenes). Everything else utilizes handcrafted and/or default engine assets.
RELEASE DATE:
November 10, 2024
